heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers likely, then slowly tapering off; maybe a rumble of thunder. Patchy fog east of the Greens. Early lows from the mid 40s to lower 50s east of the Greens, and in the St. Lawrence Valley, mid 50s to around 60 elsewhere west of the Greens. South to southeast winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, becoming southwest late.

heading: Wednesday
text: Patchy fog early east of the Greens. Otherwise mostly cloudy with the chance of a morning shower, with a few lingering showers possible in the northern mountains after noon; a few breaks of afternoon sun possible in southern valleys. Highs in 60s south, and mid 50s to around 60 north, except some lower 50s northeast. Southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, becoming northwest.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Periods of clouds, and a few mountain showers north. Becoming partly cloudy in southern valleys. Breezy and cooler. Lows from the mid 30s to lower 40s, with some lower 30s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Northwest winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.
